AccessRequest.title: AccessRequest
AccessRequest.description: User access request and approval status managed exclusively by the sole Admin (chanthathonglith@gmail.com).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requesting user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google profile.

photoURL.description: User avatar URL from Google profile.

reason.description: Department or purpose note submitted with access request.

status.description: Current approval state controlled exclusively by Admin.

reviewedByEmail.description: Admin email that last reviewed the request.

adminNote.description: Optional note recorded by Admin upon approval or rejection.

requestedAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest modification.

WorkspaceConfig.title: WorkspaceConfig
WorkspaceConfig.description: Shared Google Spreadsheet reference published by Admin for approved team members.

spreadsheetId.description: Google Spreadsheet ID shared across approved accounts.

updatedByEmail.description: Admin email that saved the shared configuration.

/accessRequests/{userId}.description: Per-user access approval documents keyed by Firebase UID.

/workspaceConfig/{configId}.description: Shared workspace configuration document readable by approved users and writable only by sole Admin.
